text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe this!! Missing the bus, of 
all things!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, nothin' I can do about missin' 
it. I sent you a message, so just sit 
tight and wait.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Listen, I'm not like you. I had plans to 
preview and review my lessons once I got 
home, and all sorts of other things!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I already apologized like a million times 
for nodding off, didn't I?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Exactly that! You go and fall asleep 
outside, and then treat me like that when 
I come get you?! Do you even know how to 
apologize properly?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't ask you to come pick me up, 
dammit!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Haaah!? Honestly, you always—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...*Sigh*, never mind. Yelling will only 
tire me out anyway."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Guess so. Even if you shout yourself 
hoarse, there aren't any vending machines 
around here anyway.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...The stars are incredible, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Though during training, I barely 
even looked up at the sky.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It was a last-minute training camp, so it 
can't be helped. You were desperate not to 
waste the opportunity, right? Well... I 
felt the exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...It gets chilly when you stand still, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Want me to lend you a track jacket?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No need. More importantly, lend me a 
shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: H-Hey.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Quiet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Mmh, is my ride here yet, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yeah... I guess so.
